banners.kind: Original AI-generated atmospheric pixel-art environments with subtle ambient animation; not official branding.
banners.paletteBasis: Verified teams: colors inspired by their downloaded avatars. Unverified teams: complementary colors based on the VOLO SCHOOL team tints.
banners.motion: Six softly drifting motes and a localized illumination shimmer of at most 3% opacity. Matching first-frame stills for pause and reduced motion.

scenes.greenmind: Ecology: a lush rooftop greenhouse with community garden beds, seedlings and gardening tools.
scenes.quryltai: Education and mentoring: a sunlit learning studio with shared desks, open books and blue library shelves.
scenes.shuaq: Arts and culture: an atmospheric art studio with a canvas, brushes, paints, an instrument and burgundy curtains.
scenes.orken: Events and leadership: a contemporary university forum with a podium, seating and volunteer planning materials.
scenes.januia: Supporting children: a warmly lit reading nook with picture books, cushions, a teddy and building blocks.
scenes.samga: Sport and inclusion: an accessible athletics hall with track lanes, a sports wheelchair, running shoes and a ball.
scenes.polaris: Technology for good: a collaborative coding workshop with monitors, electronics, notebooks and a robotics project.
scenes.pulse: Care and mental well-being: a calm peer-support lounge with two chairs, warm mugs and a leafy courtyard.
scenes.key-to-life: Charity and connection across generations: a community sharing room with books, blankets, food baskets and parcels.

artProduction.direction: Atmospheric pixel-art environments, detailed materials, soft natural lighting and no human figures.
artProduction.preparation: Each 1024×1536 sheet has three panels. FFmpeg crops each to 1024×448 at y=35,539,1040, then downsamples 2× with nearest-neighbor to the committed 512×224 source art.
